input: Frozen image_only encoder pool; unique FIT StandardScaler/PCA128 and L2 normalization
optimizer: L-BFGS-B; maxiter=300; same zero initialization; candidate marginal objective is nonconvex, so this is one controlled start, not a global-optimum claim
assumption: Candidate marginal loss treats supplied FIT classes for the identical input as alternatives. This is an experimental modeling assumption, not verified clinical truth or a modification of original record labels. Marginal loss discards within-set target proportions while retaining group mass and candidate membership. Groups with every class have no marginal-loss supervision.
